contracts.VIDEO_REFRESH_RATE_HZ: System_InitializeRuntime derives 50 or 60 Hz from VDP status; Scene_EnterTransitionMode selects the 50 Hz presentation row when the value is 0x32.
contracts.SCENE_SCRIPT_WAIT: LevelEvent_ArmSceneScriptTransition sets the latch while arming the scene-script countdown, and SceneScript_AdvanceState tests it for type-2 records.
contracts.MENU_OPTIONS_INITIAL_PRESENTATION_LATCH: Menu_RunOptionsPresentationContinuation sets the latch after the initial presentation and tests it before the shared transition-audio epilogue.

limitations: The menu latch's role is limited to its exact presentation/audio gate; its broader user-facing state is not inferred.
No runtime promotion is claimed for the scene-transition path.
conclusion: Three previously address-only RAM references now resolve to canonical semantic identities without changing native behavior or generated ROM ownership.
